George Michael | George Michael winds down his 25 Live tour in his first-ever concert film, which finds the former Wham! leading man revisiting hits familiar and fresh in two sold-out shows at London's Earls Court. Michael's impeccable vocals take center stage, and his pop-song prowess is driven home with such classics as "Faith", "Freedom" and "One More Try". Even "Careless Whisper" gets a nod, as does the Police's "Roxanne".

lista.titulo: Peter Gabriel: New Blood/Live in London
lista.descripcion: Filmado en el Hammersmith Apollo, New Blood Live In London muestra a Peter Gabriel actuando en directo con la New Blood Orchestra, formada por 46 músicos. El repertorio mezcla versiones de su álbum Scratch My Back con temas clásicos de su carrera en solitario en nuevos arreglos orquestales. Gabriel es un reconocido intérprete en directo, y su carisma sobre el escenario y su voz reconocible al instante se combinan a la perfección con la paleta de sonidos orquestales para insuflar un nuevo sentido de maravilla a canciones conocidas. Como era de esperar, el concierto es también un festín visual, con gráficos, animación e imágenes que se mezclan para realzar e ilustrar la música en 3D. Una experiencia en directo que no debe perderse.

John Mayall | Liverpools Kings Dock on July 19 2003 was the venue for a long awaited and much anticipated reunion between Eric Clapton and John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers. The occasion was both a celebration of John Mayalls 70th year and a fundraiser for Unicef. Also invited to the party were former Bluesbreaker and Rolling Stone Mick Taylor and veteran trombonist Chris Barber. If youre a lover of the blues it doesnt get much better than this. The show ran for around two and a half hours and the film is now presented here in its entirety for the first time.
